Map profile used for world generation.
tfc_real_world.create_world.spawn_mode.t:
Determines how the appearance point location is calculated.
Default - uses standard coordinates.
Geographic - uses real-world longitude and latitude.
Random - generates randomly from world seed.
tfc_real_world.create_world.spawn_center: Geographic longitude for appearance point location (used in Geographic mode).
Geographic latitude for appearance point location (used in Geographic mode).
tfc_real_world.create_world.horizontal_t: Horizontal size of each world region in blocks. Affects how real-world maps are stretched over the world.
tfc_real_world.create_world.vertical_til: Vertical size of each world region in blocks. Affects distances between poles and world wrapping.
